campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered updates to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, and the annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27. The Council also considered a budget adjustment to fund a replacement project.
keyTopics: Proposed modifications to Council Policy Section 14, the theater use policy
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for resurfacing work
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund a replacement project

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business including meeting minutes, vendor payments, and a conflict of interest code update, alongside two final map approvals for lot subdivisions. The Council also heard two appeals of Planning Commission decisions on residential development projects, and discussed law enforcement service options ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Final map approvals for lot subdivisions at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a single-family residence and ADU design review/setback variance at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a three-lot subdivision, design review, and CEQA exemption at 14486 Oak Place
Law enforcement service options discussion ahead of September 19 and September 30 town hall meetings
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered routine administrative items along with a temporary moratorium on new detention or custodial processing facilities in the city. The Council also reviewed appointments to city commissions and the VTA Board, a wastewater treatment agreement, and an updated legal services contract.
keyTopics: Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on applications for detention or custodial processing facilities
Appointments to the Complete Streets, Environmental, and Planning Commissions
Councilmember Jonathan D. Weinberg's continued service on the Valley Transportation Authority (VTA) Board
Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Amendment to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, setting a $21,500 monthly retainer and $385 hourly rate

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine business, including approval of minutes from prior meetings and a monthly financial and investment report for July 2026. The Council also considered several contract actions, including amendments to existing agreements and new professional services agreements, along with an amendment related to heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Town Council and Closed Session meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026
Second amendment to an existing agreement (Town Manager authorization)
First amendment to a heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services agreement
New professional services agreements for the Town

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 23, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole reviewed the upcoming City Council agendas for September 29 and October 6, 2026, including whether any items needed new additions or a scheduled speaking time. The committee also looked at the public record for a recent one-week period, reviewed mayoral travel requests, and considered approving District 1 San Jose Sharks Community Funds for the California Association of Local Agency Formation Commissions.
keyTopics: Review and finalization of the September 29, 2026 Council agenda
Review of the October 6, 2026 draft Council agenda
Public record review for September 10-17, 2026
Mayor's requests to travel
District 1 Sharks Community Funds approval for the California Association of Local Agency Formation Commissions

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — September 22, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met in closed session to discuss potential litigation involving several fire truck manufacturers and to consider a City Attorney appointment, then held a regular session covering proclamations, city services, and infrastructure projects. Key business included updates to Shoreline athletic fields, a solar and battery energy storage project, a historic preservation ordinance update, an active transportation plan, and pay raises for council-appointed staff.
keyTopics: Potential litigation involving fire apparatus manufacturers (Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer, FAMA) and a City Attorney appointment discussed in closed session
Professional services agreement for renovating the Shoreline athletic fields
Energy services contract for solar panels and battery storage systems
Update to the Historic Preservation Ordinance and zoning map
Adoption of the Active Transportation Plan and pay increases for the City Clerk and City Manager

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 19, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: This was a special morning session of the Sunnyvale City Council focused on the annual 'State of the City' event, rather than regular legislative business. The agenda covered event logistics and standard meeting procedures, including how residents could participate or comment.
keyTopics: State of the City special meeting and event schedule
Options for in-person and online public comment
Procedures for submitting written public comment and materials to Council

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 15, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met to discuss potential litigation and a real estate negotiation involving Cupertino Union School District property, recognized local high school students for a business competition award, and worked through a Consent Calendar covering city audits, AI policy, and a response to a county grand jury report on pothole damage claims. An ordinance updating building code definitions was postponed to a later meeting.
keyTopics: Closed session on anticipated litigation and negotiations over price and terms for the property at 10480 Finch Avenue with Cupertino Union School District
Recognition of Cupertino High School students for their achievements at the 2026 FBLA National Leadership Conference
Postponement of an ordinance amending municipal code definitions of 'attic,' 'garages,' and 'square footage' to October 6, 2026
Adoption of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) City Council Policy and appointment of an ad-hoc subcommittee to evaluate city lobbyist proposals
Approval of the city's response to the Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury report on pothole damage claims processes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council and Stadium Authority Board held a joint meeting that opened with closed-session discussions on legal matters, including litigation over water/power costs and a property damage claim. The open session included several proclamations and considered agreements for HVAC control systems and office furnishings, while a proposed housing ordinance amendment was deferred.
keyTopics: Closed session on litigation with the California Department of Water Resources over Silicon Valley Power/Northern California Power Agency costs
Closed session on a property damage claim filed by Travelers Insurance on behalf of Moriel Real Estate, LLC
Deferral of an ordinance to establish new zoning rules for replacement housing units required by state law
Proclamations recognizing Hispanic Heritage Month, Childhood Cancer Awareness Month, and Public Power Week
Consideration of a contract with Syserco, Inc. for HVAC control systems and an increased purchase order for office furnishings with D & D Learning Spaces

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered several financial and infrastructure items, including the city's federal housing and community development grant plan, the condition of the Milpitas Community Center, and refinancing bonds tied to the former Redevelopment Agency. The Council also received a presentation on the city's red light camera traffic safety program.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolutions related to refunding bonds for the Successor Agency to the former Redevelopment Agency
City Council calendar of upcoming meetings

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Architectural Review Board — September 17, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Architectural Review Board considered a proposed sign program for the office property at 950 Page Mill Road, including a shared monument sign that would display the property's own branding ('Page Mill Labs') alongside identification panels for four individual tenants. The board's role was to make a recommendation on the design proposal.
keyTopics: Master Sign Program proposal for 950 Page Mill Road
Multi-tenant monument sign featuring 'Page Mill Labs' property branding
Four separate tenant identification panels included in the sign design
Project found exempt from CEQA under the accessory structures exemption
